candidateGroupTextOnly.title: Prototype demonstration instructions
candidateGroupTextOnly.passage: Thank you for helping with tomorrow's product demonstration. Each table will have one prototype, one charging cable, and one feedback form. Connect each unit to its charger tonight and check that demonstration mode is on. Visitors may try the touch controls, but the settings menu should remain locked because some functions are still under development. If a unit freezes, use the backup unit at the reception table and record the event. We want detailed feedback rather than estimates of when the product will ship.

rationaleEN.80: Tonight the hosts plug in every unit and check that demonstration mode is on; shipping, removing feedback forms and unlocking settings are not requested.
rationaleEN.81: Development functions are unfinished, so the settings menu stays locked. The talk does not attribute the lock to language, batteries or feedback form status.
rationaleEN.82: Use the backup unit from reception and record the incident; do not promise shipping timing, cancel every demo or have visitors repair hardware.

units.priorDiagnosis: Original full Whisper clearly found the key charge and mode; independent Vosk and focused reruns failed to resolve charge and rendered spare as despair. Fix the key action wording, specify setup list count without reduced articles, and make the backup instruction harder to mishear. Neither old mismatch is established as an actual generation defect.

candidateGroupTextOnly.title: Inventory counting notice
candidateGroupTextOnly.passage: The warehouse will conduct its quarterly inventory count on Friday afternoon. Material requests needed for Friday's production must reach us by eleven in the morning. From noon to four, we will handle safety emergencies only. Team leaders should assign one person to confirm quantities with warehouse staff. For sealed boxes, use the quantity on the label unless the seal is damaged. Regular material pickup starts again at four thirty in the afternoon.
